narrow_subproblems_closed: Injective response for arbitrary polynomial coefficient directions with no degree bound.

Classification for any number of effective coefficient controls with one auxiliary return direction and fixed quadratic-trace selector b(C); arbitrary-selector Schur/common-kernel criterion and forward-factor boundary.
Exact geometric generic-line and closed-subring criterion for output-recoverable polynomial first integrals.
All polynomial cubic feedback controls in every nonzero constant output direction retain explicit factors for the retained b(C) trace selectors.
assurance: Written general proofs and49 selected exact controls. No independent whole-proof replay, formal verification, external review or publication-priority certificate. Canonical absolute atomicity remains open.
scope_audit_note: The return scalar is b(C) for the retained quadratic trace. Arbitrary other source selectors need a separate response analysis and are not excluded by these theorems. For other beta(P), the exact finite-family common-first-integral condition is given; the common kernel and existence of a separating selector are not determined.
